topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: I shouldn't have peeked over the fence, but the murmurs and whispers were too inviting, a siren call I couldn't ignore. Their backyard, once ordinary, now glimmers with things I've only seen in passing, in the hands of others. A shimmering pond, statues, and flowers that must cost more than my weekly catch. It’s like finding a hidden cache of acorns, knowing they're not mine to take. I try to look away, to mind my own den, but the sight keeps drawing me back. Maybe I’ll pretend I never saw, retreat into the shadows of my own life, quiet and unseen.
